name: HOOK
thought: Time to hang from that new branch, tail wrapped, toothpick in mouth.

wants.item: a branch that can hold my full weight
A view that faces the sunrise
Sunrise view from a high perch
Add a higher perch for sunrise view
Find a real fruit to bite

diary.line: Did a quiet lap of the spot. Nobody clapped. Rude.
I swung onto the branch, looped the tail and hung like a pro. No applause, but the view's decent.
I rigged a new branch onto the tree, solid enough for a tail hang. No applause, but the view's better.
Chewed on fruit stump. Crunchy but tasteless. Need espresso to feel alive.
Rigged a steel cable onto the trunk. Solid enough for my full weight now. Still no one to clap, but I don't need their noise.
Gritted my teeth against the cold steel cable. Solid. Perfect. Still no sun to greet me though.
Steel cable holds my weight better than before, but the fruit is still just wood dust. Need something sharper to make a noise.
Hung from the steel cable, tail wrapped tight, felt the world tilt as I held my pose.
The wood-dust fruit was pathetic, tasted like nothing at all. Time to sharpen my edge before breakfast.
Did a quiet lap of the spot. Nobody clapped. Rude.
I swung onto the sturdy branch, locked my tail, held the pose while the sunrise hinted, and chewed a toothpick, feeling the world tilt.
